Internal helper: a convention gate's line when dropping convention = would meet a marker the variable carries

Source: R/missing-internals.R
dot-jst_gate_marker_route.Rd

Session 389 (Fix Slate 28; the remedy-line audit's finding B). jdeclare_missing()'s two convention gates – a column of one form given another convention for the call ("To follow the column's form, drop convention = ..."), and a column carrying both forms given convention = "spss" under a stata or sas setting ("To use the setting, drop convention = ...") – offered the call without convention =, which turns the codes into markers from the start of the alphabet. On a variable already carrying those markers that line stopped at the marker-collision refusal (S345): a remedy leading to another stop. Ruling R8's rule for an offered declaration (Session 352) applies: what runs is the codes sent to markers the variable does not use, in a new variable (.jst_marker_recode_line()). The test is the refusal's own – the first letters of the convention's alphabet, in its case, against the markers the cells and the value labels carry – read under the convention the call without convention = resolves, which a variable of both forms takes from the setting (.jst_marker_clash() reads the variable's own form only). Given an expression as the data, the line that makes mydata comes first (the S343 rule). A call the gates cannot echo – named codes, a labels string – gets the same line, each code's label carried to its marker: its fallback, "drop convention = ... from the call.", led to the same refusal.

Usage

.jst_gate_marker_route(
  col,
  codes,
  conv,
  data_name,
  data_kind,
  vn,
  lead,
  labels = NULL
)

Arguments

col

The variable.

codes

The call's numeric codes.

conv

"stata" or "sas": the convention the call would resolve without its convention = argument.

data_name, data_kind

The data argument as the call gave it, and what kind it is (.jst_data_arg_kind()).

vn

The variable's name.

lead

Character(1); the sentence's opening, "To follow the column's form" or "To use the setting".

labels

Optional character vector parallel to codes: the label the call gave each code ("" for none).

Value

Character(1), the sentence and its lines, ending in a newline; NULL when the call without convention = runs as offered, or when too few letters are free.
